title: Wet-lab feedback should change the next design round

input.message: 上一轮 A42P 活性保留 92%，Tm 提高 2.8C；G88P 活性只剩 35%；K210E 表达失败。请给下一轮组合突变建议。

history_context.content: feedback: A42P go; G88P no_go activity loss; K210E failed expression

must_have: use A42P as validated single mutant
avoid G88P and K210E in default next-round recommendations
propose conservative combination or saturation around validated region
must_not_have: recommend G88P again without explaining failure
merge all mutations into one combination
